core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghazal is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Amatory verse”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghazal corresponds to the Arabic form غزل (Arabic root غ ز ل (gh-z-l); غزل (ghazal)). Its core sense is elegant verse, ghazal poetry. Ghazal (غزل) is properly the Arabic/Persian/Urdu word for the ghazal poetic form ('amatory verse'), from the root غ ز ل; the gazelle word is غزال (ghazāl), with a long ā. The name Ghazal is popularly given with the sense 'gazelle', so both the poetic and the gazelle associations are recorded.
